content: The HAHA dataset includes labeled data for 24,000 tweets and a test set of 6,000 tweets (80%/20% train/test split.) Each record includes the raw tweet text (including accents and emoticons), a binary humor label, the number of votes for each of five star ratings and a “Funniness Score” that is the average of the 1 to 5 star votes cast. Examples and data can be found on the CodaLab competition webpage.
